newsitem.title: USA: Rubin declines to comment on Fed, sees solid growth.
newsitem.headline: Rubin declines to comment on Fed, sees solid growth.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin declined on Tuesday to comment on the Federal Reserve's decision to keep its interest rate policy unchanged.
"I never comment on the Fed as you know," Rubin said on leaving a Senate Approriations subcommittee hearing on contributions to international financial institutions.
Rubin said he thought the U.S. economy was continuing "on a path where the most likely outcome was solid growth with low inflation."
Asked about dollar, Rubin said "our policy on the dollar remains the same, as it has consistently."
